title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease TRAC Terminal Rental Adjustment and Sale Settlement Terms
content:
# Terminal Rental Adjustment Terms — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

## Article 1 — When a settlement is posted

A sale settlement can be posted only while the unit status is sold, as the unit's system record shows.

## Article 2 — Net proceeds and book value

(a) *No longer in force:* the clause "Net proceeds are the gross sale proceeds less the sale expenses less the remarketing fee for the tier" is no longer in force as written here; it has been superseded by the current basis for net proceeds.

(b) The unit's book value at the sale date is retired.

## Article 3 — The adjustment on a TRAC unit

(a) For a TRAC unit, when net proceeds exceed book value the business is credited the tier's surplus share percentage of the excess, rounded to the nearest cent, applied first to other charges due on the master agreement where the tier applies the surplus first.

(b) *No longer in force:* the clause "when they fall short the shortfall is billed as a deficiency" is no longer in force as written here; it has been superseded by the current basis for TRAC deficiencies.

(c) *No longer in force:* the clause by which that deficiency is "due the deficiency payment period in calendar days after the settlement invoice" is no longer in force as written here; it has been superseded by the current basis for paying a TRAC deficiency.

(d) The result is even when net proceeds and book value are equal.

## Article 4 — Closed-end commercial units

For a closed-end commercial unit there is no terminal rental adjustment: the adjustment result is not applicable and Kestrel keeps any gain or loss.

## Article 5 — Closing

The unit schedule closes once its charges due are zero.

## Surplus credit, worked (hypothetical)

A TRAC unit in a tier with a 95 percent surplus share has net proceeds a hypothetical 2000.40 above its book value. The credit is 95 percent of 2000.40, that is 1900.38. Where the tier applies the surplus first to other charges due on the master agreement, the credit goes to those charges first.

| Net proceeds against book value | TRAC unit | Closed-end commercial unit |
|---|---|---|
| Above | surplus share credited | not applicable; Kestrel keeps the gain |
| Equal | even | not applicable |
| Below | deficiency | not applicable; Kestrel keeps the loss |
